what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals moved to grant a special permit for a used-car dealership at 40 Summer Street; a voice vote of ayes was heard, with no individual count audible.
The permit carries conditions: a cap on the number of vehicles, cars set back from the street, set hours of business, and a certificate of occupancy before opening.
The applicant, Web Motors Group, described its plans; members asked about repairs, vehicle sourcing, titles, hours and safety access.
No one from the public spoke when the chair opened public comment, and there was no Zoom participation.

why_it_matters: This is a land-use decision on a business at one Summer Street address, so it bears on nearby traffic, hours and what operates on the street, not on the town or school budget.
The permit is conditional: the dealership cannot open until the building official's certificate of occupancy is obtained.
